subject: Consolidate exec slot for Aurora Systems demo — need VP/CTO in same window
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@aurora-sys.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tara Li <tara.li@aurora-sys.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora demo — can we add CTO/VP?

Irene,

Quick ask — Tara (our VP of Product) and our CTO would like to join next week's demo if possible. Tara can be flexible but our CTO is traveling and only has a narrow window around his arrival on Monday afternoon. Is there any way to move the demo so both can attend together?

We'd prefer a single consolidated session (45 min) rather than separate follow-ups. If we have to split, we can do a short CTO handoff, but Tara strongly prefers to be in the main walkthrough.

Samir
Aurora Systems

Attachment: flight_itinerary.txt (stated ETA for CTO arrival: Mon 12 Jul — lands 13:05 PT)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@aurora-sys.com>
Cc: Tara Li <tara.li@aurora-sys.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora demo — can we add CTO/VP?

Thanks Samir — good to hear Tara and the CTO want to join. We can probably accommodate but need to confirm a few things on our side (VP availability and engineer coverage).

Can you confirm whether Tara prefers morning or afternoon PT on Monday 12 Jul? If the CTO is landing ~13:05 PT, a consolidated 45-minute slot between 11:30–12:15 PT would let Tara and most of our team be present and still give the CTO time to clear customs and jump on remotely if needed. Alternatives: 12:30–13:15 PT (CTO likely to be enroute) or a split: 30-min walkthrough with Tara then 15-min CTO Q&A when he joins.

I've attached an updated agenda (agenda_v2.pdf) with a condensed run-of-show for a 45-min session. If you confirm Tara's preference, I'll coordinate with Karthik and Marcus to lock resources.

Best,
Irene
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: agenda_v2.pdf (45-min condensed run-of-show)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 18:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora demo — internal availability

Irene — quick internal check. Tara's team can shift to 11:30–12:15 PT; Marcus and I can cover the full session. Two operational notes from infra side:

- If we compress to 45 minutes we should trim the deep perf section to the appendix and focus on the business flows + live around 20 minutes.
- If the CTO can only join remotely for the last 10–15 minutes, plan a 30+15 split: run the demo with Tara for Q&A, then bring the CTO in for architecture/scale questions. We'll prepare a 10-slide backup architecture deck for him to reference.

Either option works — I'd prefer consolidated 11:30–12:15 PT if Aurora confirms. I'll standby to update the invite and assign roles (demo lead: Marcus; infra Q&A: Karthik).

Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Samir Gupta <samir@aurora-sys.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tara Li <tara.li@aurora-sys.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 20:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora demo — can we add CTO/VP?

Irene — thanks, that helps. Tara says she can move to 11:30–12:15 PT on Monday 12 Jul. Our CTO (Rahul) is landing at 13:05 PT but may be able to join remotely earlier if the flight clears — he asked for a short consolidated 45-min if that works. He'd rather not have two separate sessions.

Can you send a calendar invite once you lock the time? We'll confirm Rahul's remote status earliest Monday morning.

Samir

Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Aurora demo — Mon 12 Jul 11:30–12:15 PT (consolidated)

Samir / Tara — thanks for the quick turn. We have locked Monday 12 Jul, 11:30–12:15 PT for a consolidated walkthrough. Calendar invite sent. Plan below (attached agenda_v2.pdf):

Run-of-show (45 min)
- 0–5 min: Intros & goals (Irene)
- 5–25 min: Product walkthrough (Marcus)
- 25–35 min: Live performance & scale highlights (Karthik) — truncated to essentials
- 35–45 min: Exec Q&A (Tara & Rahul) — architecture + roadmap focus

Contingency: if Rahul cannot join live by 11:40 PT, we'll proceed with Tara and record the architecture Q&A, then 10–15 min follow-up with Rahul later in the day. Marcus will have the backup deck ready.

Docs and links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/38291 (deal), agenda_v2.pdf (attached).

Attachments: agenda_v2.pdf (condensed run-of-show)

Looking forward — see you Monday.
